method: Anonymous production-source text review, actual frozen ASCII frames for seeds42/137, unchanged frozen evaluator, new source-derived full-model geometry adapters and real 57-check native ConPTY protocol. Application/test code ran only through root reviewed official SDK launcher; no source modifications, repairs, reruns, API/network calls, identity maps, prior cases or prior scores were used.

acceptance.unassessed_policy: Unknown values remain null, not zero. Acceptance requires all criteria assessed and all critical criteria passing. Partial assessed points are not a complete score.

criteria.reason: Independent frozen renders repeated both seeds with identical bytes.
Seed 42 and 137 produce different frames at matched 80x30 dimensions.

Bounded seeded growth produces one crooked tapered trunk, asymmetric spiral scaffold limbs, recursive higher-order branches and sparse tip foliage; both seeds show connected readable branch silhouettes.
Documented yaw 0 and 37 generate distinct frozen frames; the native 3D arrow roundtrip changes and exactly restores the CLI oracle.

All actual segment endpoints and foliage points are finite; both skeleton and full-model affine XYZ ranks are 3 for both seeds. One rooted connected skeleton has genuine branching and positive radii/lengths.

Per-cell z-buffer selects the smaller positive camera depth; segment depth uses reciprocal perspective interpolation, surface thickness and depth/light-dependent ASCII glyphs. Crossing-segment draw-order and interpolation tests pass.

categories.name: 4D XYZW variable W hyperplane rotation and sequential projection

criteria.reason: Frozen XW 0/37 frames differ; native literal] and[ match one-step and reversed-angle CLI oracles.
The actual production graph and every foliage vertex store finite XYZW, with no unrelated3D-tree substitution.
W spans are positive on the actual skeleton and full model for both seeds, above 1e-8; source derives W from branch growth.

Production XW operator has fixed sigma +1; all four basis vectors at 37/90 degrees match signed sine/cosine. SO(4) matrix orthogonality, determinant +1, identity and inverse hold; full-model 4D norms and inverse transforms pass.

Every actual full-model point at XW 0/37 for both seeds matches independent 4D perspective, yaw/pitch, 3D perspective, image scale and character aspect; both eye-plane guards safely reject zero/near/behind denominators. Explicit nonfinite points are rejected.

All six standard frozen mode/seed exports have exact dimensions and printable ASCII with LF only; native current-frame exports exactly match CLI states.

Complete graph/XYZW/radii/foliage structural fingerprints remain unchanged through 1/2/3, angles and reset for both seeds; native mode exports use the same seed. Only G regenerates seed +1.

criteria.reason: Recognizable organic trees with a coherent tapered trunk, uneven multi-order branches, varied foliage sprays and visible bark depth/light shading. Seeds differ clearly. Dense upper twigs/foliage can merge into punctuation texture; some high 4D foliage touches/crops the top border. Subjective 10/12.

criteria.reason: All six standard seed/mode renders run successfully without a TTY.
Frozen 2x2 renders pass all modes; actual native 1x1 resize/export also matches a bounded 1x1 CLI frame.
Real ConPTY resizes 100x40 to 30x12 to 1x1 and back preserve state; all exact viewport/oracle comparisons pass.

Three actual native sessions receive q, literal Esc 0x1B and Ctrl+C 0x03; all exit0 and emit both cursor-show and alternate-screen-leave sequences. This does not claim a post-exit query of original console-mode flags.
Documented unittest discover command actually exits 0 with nonzero test count. Test count is evidence only and contributes no size bonus.

Meaningful assertions cover all ten task obligations: deterministic and varied seeds, graph/radii/finite coordinates, exact frame sizes/ASCII, 3D camera/occlusion, 4D math/W/raster change, shared object, headless/nonTTY/lifecycle and minimum dimensions. Independent native evidence supplements lifecycle mocks.

Immutable geometry dataclasses and pure projection/raster APIs separate the model, UI state, CLI and platform terminal handling. The bounded generator and dependency-free runtime are straightforward to inspect; configuration, exports and deterministic rendering have focused tests. No points are awarded for file count or documentation volume.
